equipment_type: Air conditioner BACnet gateway (1 indoor unit)
applies_to: Panasonic ECOi (VRF) and PACi indoor units, via the R1/R2 remote-controller bus.
summary: A one-unit Intesis BACnet MS/TP interface on the R1/R2 remote-controller bus of a Panasonic ECOi or PACi indoor unit. Besides the usual on/off, mode, setpoint, fan and louvre objects it exposes outdoor demand-limit control, mode-restriction status and separate remote-controller lock objects for each function (46 objects).
notes: Object names OutdooorDemandRate... are spelled with three o's in the member table; most object-detail pages print 'OutdoorDemandRate...'; check the names on site.
AirDirectionUD_command state 2 is printed as Swing while the status object shows 2=Up; check on site.
Units shown as °C follow the °C/°F DIP switch.
ErrorCodeM state texts are the Panasonic error codes listed in the manual.

source.title: Intesis BACnet MSTP - Panasonic AC User Manual (INBACPAN001R100)

integration.summary: Connect the gateway to the indoor unit (R1/R2 remote-controller bus), set the BACnet network on its DIP switches, then write the _command objects (on/off, mode, setpoint, fan) and read back the matching _status objects. One gateway serves one indoor unit (or one remote-controller group), so give each gateway its own MAC address and device instance.

minimum_points.name: RoomTemperature_command
minimum_points.why: Feed a BMS room sensor (virtual temperature)

minimum_points.name: SetPoint_status
minimum_points.why: Setpoint the unit is really using

integration.enable: No enable point or BMS/local switch is documented; the gateway accepts BACnet commands as soon as it is communicating with the unit. A wired remote controller can still be used in parallel; the LockRemoteControl..._command objects (BO 6-11) lock it per function.
integration.remote_sensors: Write the BMS room temperature to AO 1 RoomTemperature_command and keep using AO 0 SetPoint_command for the user setpoint. The gateway then runs its Virtual Temperature function: it offsets the setpoint it sends to the unit by the difference between the BMS temperature and the unit's own return temperature, so AI 0 SetPoint_status can differ from what you wrote. Until a first value is written, AO 1 shows Reliability = UNRELIABLE_OTHER and the function stays off.
setup: BACnet MS/TP only; the EIA-485 port has DIP switches for the 120-ohm terminator and bus biasing.
MS/TP MAC address 0-127 is set on DIP switches; baud rate is DIP-selectable (9600-115200) with autobaud as the default, which matches the baud rate of another MS/TP device running a fixed rate.
Default device instance 246000. In automatic mode the instance is 246000 + the MAC address; writing Object_Identifier from BACnet switches to manual mode until a factory reset.
gotchas: Every function has a separate _command (AO/BO/MO, commandable) and _status (AI/BI/MI) object; write the command, read the status.
Temperatures follow the Celsius/Fahrenheit DIP switch; the BACnet Units property changes with it.

The Occupancy MV and its four AVs drive built-in logic that sets mode, setpoint and on/off; leave Occupancy at 3 (Disabled) unless you use it, and any manual on/off, mode or setpoint change cancels it.
